issues: This is a 聴解 (listening) page: only the four printed choices appear for each item; the question stems are spoken, so each question block has an empty text field.

No 問題N heading is printed on this page, so partNumber is null for all three blocks. From the booklet structure (choices printed for each 番) this is most likely 聴解 問題1 or 問題2, but that was not confirmed on this page.
In 5番 choices 1 and 3, the glyph after 入り is rendered ambiguously between kanji 口 and katakana ロ in the scan; transcribed as 入り口 (kanji) based on the word 入り口.
